notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
- Expanded late-game content
   - Items Unlocks
   - Extended story
   - Glitches has an expanded Sacred Tree dream

- New character farming abilities
   - Spaz has longer days
   - Soul doubles level when waking up
   
- Improvements to the final boss
   - 2 New boss fazes
   - More kittens for Nugget to feed
   - Boss can now be fought by having a bad dream at level 6 or more
   - Increased difficulty 
   - Fixed laser attack
   - Improved visuals 

- Character specific unlocks
   - New halo for ascending that increases stats
   - New item unlocks for beating the boss for any given character

- General UI/UX and sound improvements
   - Stat increase pop-ups
   - Farming catnip pop-ups
   - Level up pop-ups
   - Dream type pop-ups
   - Unlocking hidden character pop-ups
   - New audio to go with the pop-ups
   - New dog sounds
   - New sounds in forest dreams

- quality of life improvements
   - New UI/UX
   - Common items reroll if you have it already
   - Reggie now sells 5 seeds for $4.99
   - Glitches no longer has his ability while farming
   - Angel can no longer fly while farming
   - Shadow no longer spawns a demon dog while farming
   - Anvil item no longer soft locks the boss

- General Fixes
   - Fixed watering can
   - Fixed Reggie not selling seeds while awake
   - Fixed final boss
   - Fixed Sacred Tree getting too big
   - Fixed Ratking 
   - Fixed cat animation overlap
   - Fixed glitches transformation
